initiatives.name: Strongly Worded Letters
initiatives.description: UNO alumni-led volunteer group in Omaha that explains local government and gives residents scripts for contacting officials. Offers office hours and city budget workshops.

initiatives.name: Urban Abbey
initiatives.description: Nonprofit coffee shop, bookstore and United Methodist church at 1026 Jackson St in Omaha's Old Market. Hosts worship, a campus ministry for queer students, and community events.

initiatives.name: PFLAG Omaha
initiatives.description: The Omaha chapter of PFLAG, founded in 1984. It holds monthly peer-support meetings for LGBTQ+ people, their families, and allies at Countryside Community Church.

initiatives.name: Together Omaha
initiatives.description: Omaha nonprofit that runs food pantries and homelessness and housing programs, and does policy advocacy on food and housing. Based at 812 S 24th St.

initiatives.name: Inclusive Communities
initiatives.description: Omaha nonprofit that runs anti-bias education and leadership programs for schools, businesses, nonprofits and government agencies in Nebraska and Iowa.

initiatives.name: Omaha DSA
initiatives.description: Omaha chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America, organizing in eastern Nebraska and western Iowa on pro-union work, letter campaigns, and events.

initiatives.name: I Be Black Girl
initiatives.description: Omaha organization for Black women, femmes and girls, running community-led investments, economic opportunity, maternal health (doula training) and people power programs.

initiatives.name: Omaha Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Since 1996 Food Not Bombs Omaha has been distributing food free of charge on the corner of 14th and Farnam at 2pm every Sunday.

initiatives.name: /r/OmahaMutualAid
initiatives.description: Subreddit for Omaha Mutual Aid, a group that shares mutual aid resources and holds biweekly in-person peer support meetings at the downtown Omaha library.
